The '''Kayri system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kayri III]].
